$note: Issue #38 — the keyword rewrite pass (DECISIONS: vocabulary adopted 2026-10-03). Every text follows [timing] → keyword + amount → target → rider; 'cancel' never 'negate'; durations are 'this turn' / 'this round' / 'until the start of your next turn'; reminder text lives in keywords.json. Texts were re-read against each card's register() body: where the old text and the engine disagreed, the text now says what the engine does (see the parity list in the issue). Applied to the xlsx by `npm run retext -- packages/cards/data/rewrites/2026-10-03-keyword-pass.json`, then `npm run import-cards`.
